note: Sleep (Dave 2026-10-21, job 86, items/SLEEP_DESIGN.md). Lie down (Z) and hold Z for hold_s seconds to sleep. While asleep exertion falls strain_mult times faster than standing (lying alone is 3 times) and health regenerates regen_mult times faster; the part above lying is scaled by the quality of the place: under a roof or tree crown 'covered', open dry ground 'open_dry'. Open ground in rain (rain at or over rain_wakes) will not let you sleep and wakes you at once. You wake on any movement or stance key, a hit or a fall, a rain that reaches you, or after rested_s seconds with exertion at zero (so you do not sleep your life away). Waking from a faint is unchanged. No tiredness bar yet: sleep only rests exertion and health. Hunger and thirst run at the resting rate while lying. Build 522 (Dave 2026-10-21): going to sleep (Z) blacks out smoothly over fade_in_s like a faint, the heart in the ears slows from bpm.start to bpm.end over bpm.slow_s, you wake by yourself once energy is full AND exertion is gone for rested_s, and the wake fades back over fade_out_s with the heart at bpm.wake. Holding Space (the client sends ACT_SLEEP 0) wakes you early with energy where it was. The expected time to wake (real seconds) is sent with the heart rate in body(bpm, eta_s, phase), protocol 59.
